story.title: Swimmer Completes Challenge in Strait of Hormuz to Highlight Environmental Damage
story.summary: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh completed a 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz over three days in November 2026. The swim took place amid explosions and burning tankers, aiming to raise awareness about the environmental damage caused by the ongoing war with Iran.

related_stories.summary: Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned Russian leader Vladimir Putin as a 'killer' after a major wave of Russian strikes targeted Kyiv, resulting in at least seven fatalities. The attacks involved over 400 drones and 110 missiles, causing significant damage to infrastructure, including key bridges across the Dnipro River.

related_stories.summary: On November 20, 2026, an autonomous electric flying taxi successfully completed a passenger flight during a demonstration in Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. related_stories.title: International Court Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide Against Rohingya
related_stories.summary: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) has made a historic ruling, declaring Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya minority during a military campaign in 2017. This unprecedented decision, which found intent to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya population, marks the first time a state has been held accountable for genocide by the ICJ. The ruling has sparked varied international reactions, with Myanmar rejecting it as 'unfair' and calls for sanctions against the country emerging from rights groups. The ICJ's decision may also influence future cases regarding genocide, including allegations against Israel.

related_stories.title: Russian Missiles Land in Poland Amid NATO Exercises
related_stories.summary: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland, which Prime Minister Donald Tusk described as likely an intentional provocation. This incident coincided with European military exercises in Poland related to a potential postwar mission in Ukraine. NATO has labeled the missile landings a 'grave violation' of Polish airspace.
